description:
Found by the fz-kdt.199 cold review (2026-09-03, base ca23b676f), and named
in that ticket`s build/2 gate comment as its removal ticket so a known-unbought
split is not blessed as a law.

fz-kdt.199 keys a position when the activation`s published return is built from
it MINUS the positions the recursion supplies, and that subtraction is computed
per-function (a least fixpoint over the function`s own held positions after the
review`s fix). It cannot see a MUTUAL cycle: when the supplying step happens in
a sibling of the recursion rather than in the function itself, the position
reads as not-supplied and gets keyed.

MEASURED at fz-kdt.199: of the executables that ticket adds on key-growing
functions, 79 gain NO distinct return against 36 that do. The unbought ones are
dominated by `List.reduce_*` minting fz-kdt.182 `empty_list()` / `list(tau)`
ascent rungs across the mutual reduce_cont/reduce_step cycle.

THE FIX DIRECTION: lift the supplied-position fixpoint from the function to the
recursive COMPONENT (the strong component `derive_call_graph_component` already
computes), so a position supplied anywhere in the cycle counts as supplied.

CONCORDANT: fz-kdt.182 (the empty_list()/list(tau) interning that makes these
rungs distinct in the first place -- if unions normalised by subsumption, most
of the 79 would not exist); fz-kdt.196 (the cost of a moving fact); fz-kdt.199
(the ticket that adds them).

RED-FIRST: the 79 unbought executables fall while the 36 bought ones and every
ONE_ACTIVATION_KEYING_LAWS row stay; quicksort frontier stays at 17.

comments.text: fz-kdt.199 landed (dd07432db) and its build/2 gate names this ticket as its removal owner, so the split is recorded as a PIN rather than blessed as a law. Measured at the landing: of the executables 199 adds, 36 buy a distinct return and 91 do not (83 on the cold review's 597-fixture comparand). Top offenders: List.reduce_cont/3 (21), List.reduce_while_cont/3 (18), Range.reduce_while_cont/6 (9), reduce_while_step/3 (6) -- all the mutual reduce cycle the self-only subtraction cannot see. Red-first for you: those fall while the 36 bought ones and every ONE_ACTIVATION_KEYING_LAWS row hold, and quicksort stays at 17.

title: The returned-axis subtraction is self-only: a mutual cycle it cannot see mints 79 executables that buy no distinct return
